_comment: Human-judged expectations, NOT derived from the scoring formula. relevant_ids are songs a listener with that profile would plausibly be happy to get (ids from data/songs.csv). Review and edit these; the evaluation is only as good as this file.

ranking_cases.name: Starter lofi
ranking_cases.notes: Quiet acoustic lofi plus the calmest ambient tracks.

ranking_cases.name: Pop workout
ranking_cases.notes: The 'chill' mood contradicts a workout; a listener would want loud, non-acoustic, high-energy tracks.

ranking_cases.name: Rock intense
ranking_cases.notes: All rock songs in the catalog.

ranking_cases.name: Conflict: high-energy sad classical
ranking_cases.notes: No ideal answer exists; any classical piece is acceptable.

ranking_cases.name: Unknown genre and mood
ranking_cases.notes: No ground truth. The system should at least warn that the labels cannot match.

ranking_cases.name: Out-of-range energy (1.5)
ranking_cases.notes: Energy should be clamped to 1.0 with a warning; happy, loud, danceable songs expected.

ranking_cases.name: No matches, no acoustic pref
ranking_cases.notes: Nothing in the catalog fits. The system should warn rather than pretend.

ranking_cases.name: Metal fan wants calm
ranking_cases.notes: Contradictory profile; calm acoustic tracks are the sensible answer.

ranking_cases.name: Messy casing and whitespace
ranking_cases.notes: Must rank exactly like the clean lofi profile.

ranking_cases.name: Acoustic lover wants EDM
ranking_cases.notes: Genre and mood outweigh the acoustic preference here.

workout music that is not acoustic
pump me up for the gym
